subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Winter Morning" by answering the
stimulus: following questions. 10 (a) How is a winter morning? (b) Why do people cannot see things from distance in a winter morning? (c) What do the old people and children do to make themselves warm? (d) What are the interesting food of people in a winter morning? (e) Do you like winter morning? Why?
